paper.abstract_en: A Carrollian description of four-dimensional Yang-Mills theory on partially complexified future null infinity was recently proposed by Opreij, Skinner and Wang in arXiv:2604.09771. In this paper, we give a new form of the Carrollian Yang-Mills kinetic action on real future null infinity, and recover the logarithmic two-point function found by arXiv:2604.09771. We then extend the Carrollian description of Yang-Mills beyond scattering amplitudes by studying the expectation value of a null polygonal Wilson loop in Minkowski spacetime. We propose a boundary operator given by the trace of a cyclic product of holomorphic frames on the good cuts associated with the polygon's vertices. At order $g^2$, we show analytically that the boundary calculation reproduces the rational bulk integrand obtained from a self-dual Lagrangian insertion.

decision.reject_reason_zh: 该论文研究的是未来零无穷上的Carrollian Yang-Mills理论与零多边形Wilson圈，属于散射振幅与规范理论方向；虽然涉及零无穷的渐近结构，但并非引力理论基础（如等效原理、因果结构、奇点定理等）研究，与本索引关注的主题不匹配。
decision.abstract_zh: Opreij、Skinner 和 Wang 最近在 arXiv:2604.09771 中提出了四维 Yang-Mills 理论在部分复化未来零无穷上的 Carrollian 描述。在本文中，我们给出了实未来零无穷上 Carrollian Yang-Mills 动力学作用量的一种新形式，并重新得到了 arXiv:2604.09771 所发现的对数两点函数。随后，我们通过研究 Minkowski 时空中一个零多边形 Wilson 圈的期望值，将 Yang-Mills 的 Carrollian 描述推广到散射振幅之外。我们提出一个边界算符，它由与多边形顶点相关联的良好割线上全纯标架循环乘积的迹给出。在 $g^2$ 阶，我们通过解析方法证明，该边界计算再现了由自对偶拉格朗日量插入所得到的理性体被积函数。
